title.narrative: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cities Improvement Projects - Second Project Readiness Financing

description.narrative:
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Cities Improvement Projects (KPCIP) project readiness financing (PRF) 2 will finance the preparation and detailed engineering designs of sustainable mobility projects and a pipeline of ensuing urban projects in KPK. It is anticipated that the ensuing projects will consist of 3 projects: (i) KPK Sustainable Mobility Projects 1, (ii) KPK Sustainable Mobility Project 2, and (iii) KPCIP Project 2. The PRF 2 will promote advanced sustainable urban mobility solutions, as well as water supply and sanitation and solid waste management projects in selected cities. All subprojects will be tailored to city-specific features and urban environment.
The PRF will ensure high readiness of the ensuing projects in the urban sector in KPK, by delivering the following outputs:
Output 1: Due diligence and detailed engineering design completed and procurement activities supported. The PRF will support the refinement of due diligence of ensuing projects. Due diligence will cover technical, economic, financial, environmental and social safeguards, gender, climate change assessments, institutional framework, private sector participation opportunities, and integrity aspects of the ensuing projects. It will also support financial management assessments and procurement capacity assessments to identify risks and develop risk mitigating measures. Due diligence will include the review, validation, or upgradation of pre-existing feasibility studies and due diligence (funded by other sources). The PRF will, besides planning, support the preparation of detailed engineering design for civil works and goods or review and validate projects for which detailed engineering design has already been carried out. This will also include support for surveys, studies, geological and hydrological investigations, and other technical assessments that are necessary for preparing detailed engineering design. Climate and natural disaster resilience measures and innovations will be integrated into the engineering designs. The PRF will help prepare procurement documents and support procurement activities in line with the ADB Procurement Policy (2017, as amended from time to time) and Procurement Regulations for ADB Borrowers (2017, as amended from time to time).
Output 2: Project readiness financing implementation support provided and capacity of executing and implementing agencies improved. The PRF will finance the consulting services to support executing and implementing agencies in implementing the PRF and strengthen their capacities to sustainably operate the planned investments. Support to implementing agencies will include technical aspects, project management, financial management, procurement, gender, environmental and social safeguards. The PRF might also conduct capacity development needs assessments and develop capacity development programs for implementing agencies and government officials.
